verdict.rationale: Neon documents Project-scoped API keys alongside Personal and Organization keys, with immediate revocation and a CLI `api-keys` command to create, list and revoke them. Its hosted MCP server adds least-privilege controls for agents: read-only mode, tool-category scoping and single-project scoping, and a keyless probe confirmed the `readonly=true&category=querying` grant returns only read-safe tools. The MCP surface also lists issue/revoke/rotate tools for scoped branch credentials. Missing for 10: action-level permissions on Management API keys (scoping is only by project/org, and only admins can create project-scoped keys), and documented detail on what the branch-level scoped credentials can be restricted to.
